subject: Migrate kvstore.c unit tests to new test framework. (#446)
reason: The change is a pure test-infrastructure migration: it moves kvstore.c's unit tests (previously compiled only under #ifdef SERVER_TEST) into the new standalone unit test framework (src/unit/test_kvstore.c), removes the kvstoreTest declaration and its entry in server.c's developer-only test table, and registers the migrated tests in test_files.h. No code that runs in a production valkey-server build is modified — no command, reply, replication, persistence, or cluster path changes — so there is no behaviour a fuzzer scenario could exercise or compare.
